decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed two-storey side extension and part single-storey rear extension, due to their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site's characteristics, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the existing terrace and the street scene, and would not result in unacceptable harm to the living conditions of any adjoining occupiers or result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. On balance, the development is in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Not withstanding the condition for matching materials described above, the  western flank walls of the extensions hereby approved shall be rendered and whitewashed and permanently retained as such.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western side walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 114 Northfield Road.
Condition : 7 - No part of the roof of the resultant full width single-storey rear extension shall be used as, or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 8 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 9 - Informative: This permission does not imply any right to build on land which is not owned by the applicant.
description: Erection of a single storey part rear extension and two storey side extension to dwellinghouse
